rootCauseFindings: Ambiguous watch language caused rejected or hypothetical markets to be remembered as leans.
A live moneyline lean was issued despite a two-dragon deficit, conflicting scaling, and a stronger protected opposing carry.
The same-map repair lock was too binary and could not recognize item-qualified, structural recovery at lean level.
Series -1.5 screening did not expire aggressively enough after lineup uncertainty and an adverse first-map draft.
An intervening kill sequence was assigned to the wrong team before a lean was issued.
Kill-Under candidates were discussed at multiple lines without one explicit line-selection rule.

modelCorrections.taxonomy: Only exact LEAN verdicts enter the formal lean record; WATCH ONLY and FORCED PICK are separate.
modelCorrections.stateDirection: Require verified ownership of intervening kills, towers, and objectives before a new live lean.
modelCorrections.moneyline: Add objective-conflict and protected-carry durability gates.
modelCorrections.seriesSpread: Require confirmed lineup and expire -1.5 theses when Game 1 draft materially opposes the sweep path.
modelCorrections.handicapRepair: Allow one lean-only repaired-watch pathway after one structured conversion plus strict item, gold, structure, and cascade repair; official gate remains two conversions.
modelCorrections.killUnder: Delay early formal Unders, require a three-kill safety buffer over conservative fight budget, and select only one line.

probation.unchangedBecause: All reviewed outcomes were unplaced shadow or calibration outcomes.
